phrases.es: Me voy a quedar dos semanas.
Me hospedo en un hotel en el centro.
phrases.en: I'm staying at a hotel downtown.

scenelets.notes: Answer only what is asked. Short, factual sentences. Officers are not interested in personality here.

phrases.en: What do I need to declare?

scenelets.notes: The red/green light system: verde = go through, rojo = inspection. Prepare for rojo calmly.

phrase_cards.notes: Mexico uses visa; Spain uses visado

lines.en: Can you open your suitcase, please?

lines.es: Ropa, artículos personales, y algunos libros.
lines.en: Clothes, personal items, and some books.

authority_exchange.register_note: Never joke at customs. Calm cooperation reads as respect.

register_map.key_repair_phrase: No entendí bien. ¿Podría repetirlo, por favor? (I didn't understand well. Could you repeat that, please?)
register_map.regional_note: Mexico City (Benito Juárez) and Puerto Vallarta (Gustavo Díaz Ordaz) immigration officers are generally professional and accustomed to tourists. Patience and calm work well.
